_schema.station: modules attach to this station glb (stations/station_home.glb)
_schema.slots: attach point = EMPTY node `attach_<slot>` on station_home: position {x, y, z} in the station frame (+X dock direction, +Y left, z up = Blender), yawDeg = rotation about the up axis; the module glb origin goes on the empty and its +X along the empty +X
_schema.modules: file (models/stations/<file>.glb), label, milestone, Index Kovania point (null = cosmetic), defaultSlot, circles = collision circles in the MODULE frame (+X away from the station), circlesAtDefaultSlot = the same circles in the station frame (add them to station_home circles while the module is built)
_schema.nodes: animated / special child nodes of the module

nodes.Paint_Gantry: slides along local X (+-1.2) while painting
nodes.paint_bay: EMPTY, showcase spot of a ship being painted

nodes.trophy_0: EMPTY on a pedestal top: parent a trophy here; local +X (yaw 135 deg in the module) faces the dock camera (screen down, sim -y) on the default slot rl
nodes.trophy_1: EMPTY on a pedestal top: parent a trophy here; local +X (yaw 135 deg in the module) faces the dock camera (screen down, sim -y) on the default slot rl
nodes.trophy_2: EMPTY on a pedestal top: parent a trophy here; local +X (yaw 135 deg in the module) faces the dock camera (screen down, sim -y) on the default slot rl
nodes.trophy_3: EMPTY on a pedestal top: parent a trophy here; local +X (yaw 135 deg in the module) faces the dock camera (screen down, sim -y) on the default slot rl
nodes.trophy_4: EMPTY on a pedestal top: parent a trophy here; local +X (yaw 135 deg in the module) faces the dock camera (screen down, sim -y) on the default slot rl
nodes.trophy_5: EMPTY on a pedestal top: parent a trophy here; local +X (yaw 135 deg in the module) faces the dock camera (screen down, sim -y) on the default slot rl

nodes.Obs_Dome: dome with the slit: turn around local +Y (glTF up), pivot = dome centre
nodes.Obs_Telescope: child of the dome, pitched 48 deg; may nod around its local Z (glTF)
nodes.scout_bay: EMPTY on the launch cradle: the scout drone (drones/drone_scout) parks here (origin + landingHeight), launches along +X

nodes.Lab_Relic: Kovaci relic under analysis: slow spin around local +Y + bob; hide when no relic is being analysed

nodes.drone_pad_0..2: EMPTY landing spots of the 3 extra drone routes (pad tops)
nodes.DroneHub_Radar: traffic radar on the tower cab, spin around local +Y

trophies._schema: trophy models for the trophy_<i> pedestals: file (models/stations/<file>.glb), origin = the pedestal top (parent it to trophy_<i> with identity transform), +X = front; fit = the room on one pedestal (max horizontal extent / max height above the pedestal top) - captain replicas must be scaled into it too

nodes.Trophy_Fortress: root mesh (one draw call, no vertex colours); may turn slowly around local +Y (glTF up)

futureModules._note: all six slots have a default module after M5b; the Vyhen (Index 4) needs a new slot or replaces one (decide in M6b)
